english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for facial hair on the chin, cheeks, jaw, and neck.

examples.english: I don't like having a beard because I have to shave every morning.
examples.traditional: 我唔鍾意留鬍鬚，朝朝都要剃。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 lau4 wu4 sou1 ziu1 ziu1 dou1 jiu3 tai3
